===== 3. 写测试 (写前读/写后读) =====
-- 3a write 0xdeadbeef @ +0x10
  before: 00 00 00 00
  wr rc: True
  after : ef be ad de
-- 3b write 0x00000000 @ +0x00 (magic)
  before: 56 43 4c 4b
  wr rc: True
  after : 00 00 00 00
-- 3c write 0xffffffff @ +0x08
  before: 01 00 ff 00
  wr rc: True
  after : ff ff ff ff
-- post-write 时钟 t0: 00 00 00 00 00 10 00 00 ff ff ff ff 00 00 00 00
-- post-write 时钟 t1: 00 00 00 00 00 10 00 00 ff ff ff ff 00 00 00 00
